negatives.summary: An x2 audit repeated the invalid Windows wildcard-path form for ripgrep and failed before reading the copied phase files.
A Python console dump encountered the Windows cp1252 output codec and stopped on a Māori macron before emitting the proposal record.
One aggregate multi-function patch failed closed on a quote-context mismatch and applied no partial runtime change.
A definitions inspection assumed a RUNNER_SPECS symbol that does not exist and raised AttributeError before reading runner names.
The first current validator found one lexical collision between an ordinary accessibility field and the reserved private-callable scanner prefix.
A later index-tooling search again passed a wildcard path operand to ripgrep on Windows and failed before the corrected directory-plus-glob query.
A PowerShell word-count probe piped a foreach statement directly and failed parser validation on an empty pipe element.
